dependencies.name: cJSON
dependencies.notice: FTUN vendors the unmodified upstream parser source and header under the MIT license.

dependencies.name: heiher/lwIP
dependencies.build_boundary: static raw IPv4/IPv6 core; no socket, app, netif or OS-port sources
dependencies.notice: FTUN uses the unmodified upstream commit as a Git submodule under the three-clause BSD license.

dependencies.name: wolfSSL
dependencies.build_boundary: static client library; TLS 1.3 and SNI; no DTLS, obsolete TLS, examples, tests or install
dependencies.notice: FTUN includes the unmodified upstream source as a pinned Git submodule. This repository uses GPLv3 terms unless a distributor has obtained a suitable commercial license. wolfSSL offers commercial licensing separately.

dependencies.name: musl IP text codecs
dependencies.build_boundary: pure IPv6 text codecs adapted in src/util/ip.c; no musl OS code is compiled
dependencies.notice: IPv6 text conversion is adapted from musl inet_pton and inet_ntop. Copyright © 2005-2020 Rich Felker, et al.; MIT license retained with original source snapshots. FTUN removes the socket address-family API and errno dependency.

dependencies.name: wepoll
dependencies.build_boundary: Windows readiness backend only; upstream single-file implementation compiled privately with admitted allocation hooks; no changes to submodule sources
dependencies.notice: FTUN includes the unmodified wepoll 1.5.8 distribution as a pinned Git submodule. Copyright 2012-2020 Bert Belder. Windows builds use its epoll-style socket readiness API, backed by AFD and IOCP.

dependencies.name: Wintun API
dependencies.license: GPL-2.0 OR MIT (API header); GPL-2.0 (unused driver sources)
dependencies.build_boundary: Windows only; public api/wintun.h declarations; no upstream driver or API implementation is compiled; official signed DLL loaded at runtime via the public API
dependencies.notice: Copyright (C) 2018-2021 WireGuard LLC. All Rights Reserved. FTUN uses the API header under its MIT alternative. The unmodified official wintun.dll is a separate runtime component distributed under the Wintun Prebuilt Binaries License (LICENSE-Wintun-binaries), including the permission to accompany software using only its public API. Driver sources in this submodule are not compiled or distributed in FTUN binary packages.

distribution_toolchain.name: Zig
distribution_toolchain.notice: Zig compiler runtime and target-specific static musl or MinGW-w64 CRT are supplied by the pinned Zig distribution. macOS and Windows also use operating-system libraries.
